claude_adoption_review.choice: Keep resource and acceptance calibration as the main contribution
claude_adoption_review.reason: The data do not isolate the causal effect of editing tools. Only 5/16 unchanged-source attempts have exact-match errors, while one accepted attempt also has those errors. A tool-friction headline or claimed model improvement would exceed the evidence.

claude_adoption_review.choice: Add standard Methods/Experiments navigation and a resource card
claude_adoption_review.reason: Readers can now find contents, scale, licenses, qualified runtime and distinct integrity versus semantic replay commands. The complete overview table remains useful alongside the per-attempt figure.

claude_adoption_review.choice: Clarify same-document exclusion and witness fallback
claude_adoption_review.reason: Explicit tags in another document are not transferred to the witness. The revised text correctly explains that the one-column collision witness lacks disambiguating tags and retains the conservative float64 fallback.

claude_adoption_review.choice: Use a bounded official editing-interface comparison
claude_adoption_review.reason: The statement is limited to an interface default and explicitly disclaims measuring official-harness failure rates. It motivates a future test rather than asserting a demonstrated improvement. Independent direct page extraction was unavailable; see citation check.

claude_adoption_review.choice: Move Scientific Agent Skills to software acknowledgment
claude_adoption_review.reason: The acknowledgment records tooling contribution without suggesting that the skills paper supports the resource novelty. The new numbered reference supports an actual statement.

The first two state bounded contract-design lessons supported by the examples; the third reports the actual eight-task, 32-attempt, four-acceptance baseline. None asserts new upstream failure discovery or superiority over genuine upstream tests.

claude_adoption_review.choice: Reject invented win probabilities and no-experiment causal reframing
claude_adoption_review.reason: No competing-paper distribution or controlled intervention supports probability estimates or attributing all unchanged patches to tools.
